newsitem.title: USA: U.S. grants 10-yr, $6 bln data processing pact.
newsitem.headline: U.S. grants 10-yr, $6 bln data processing pact.

text.p: The U.S. General Services Administration said on Thursday that it has awarded a 10-year, $6 billion multiple award contract for some federal agencies to outsource data processing requirements.
Computer Sciences Corp, SunGard Computer Services Inc and Unisys Corp were named the three prime contractors of the arrangement.
All federal agencies will be able to shift its data processing requirements to outside firms, the General Services Administration said.
Federal agencies currently spend $2 billion annually on data center operations, the General Services Administration said.

SunGard Computer services teamed with GTE Corp and Universal Hi-Tech Development Inc and Unisys teamed with Affiliated Computer Services Inc, Comdisco Inc, Q Systems and Horizon Data Corp, the agency said.
